verdict.rationale: The docs show Computer runs delegated multi-step work autonomously in a cloud sandboxed VM. Tasks keep running in the background: progress notifications stream while a task runs, and callers can return later with the same thread_id to collect results. It can also act across 400+ connected services, email and calendar. However, nothing in the pack shows a way to set up persistent automations; every run starts with an explicit delegation call. Missing for 10: scheduled or recurring automations, event-driven triggers, any automation setup UI or API, and independent hands-on corroboration of unattended background runs.
